reason: I run on a treadmill at the gym after work, so a GPS route-and-crew app does very little for me, and the virtual sneakers and points loop is exactly the move-to-earn thing that cost me money in 2022. Points I can't cash out are pointless, so that whole half of the app is just a grind with nothing at the end.
objection: Gacha sneakers, repairs and upgrades are the same setup as the token apps that burned me. 'No cash-out, no payments' today feels like the step before tokens and paid draws come back.
would_change_my_mind: If it were just a clean run tracker that properly records treadmill runs, with the sneaker and point game removed or fully optional and hidden, plus a real crew I already run with asking me to join.
